title: The Tide Ledger: Series Bible & Treatment
note: Original synthetic fixture for series treatments and pitch bibles (H1-H3 hierarchy, character spotlights).

blocks.x: A six-part dramatic series examining memory, trade, and betrayal in a declining maritime borough.
When an unrecorded cargo manifests in a quarantined salt marsh, a disgraced harbormaster must choose between clearing his family name or preserving the fragile truce that keeps the harbor alive.
A stubborn municipal ledger-keeper who measures morality in metric tons.
A retired ferry pilot with an encyclopedic memory of sandbar movements.
Episode 1 begins with the arrival of the empty barge. Over the course of twelve days, tidal anomalies reveal long-buried structural fraud in the harbor foundations.
